COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
22.04.2025 CRLR No. 197 of 2020
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Ms. Abhilasha Tomar, proxy counsel for 
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for the 
revisionists.
2. Mr. Deepak Bisht, learned D.A.G. for the 
State. 
3. Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel for 
the respondent no.2/husband. 
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties. 
5. Learned counsel for the revisionist
no.1/wife and respondent no.2/husband would 
submit that they do not have any instructions 
whether the maintenance fixed by the trial court 
concerned is regularly being paid or not. 
6. In view of the above, the respondent 
no.2/husband is directed to pay the entire arrears 
of maintenance fixed by the trial court, if un-paid, 
within one month from today directly in the 
account of the revisionist no.1/wife and to keep 
on paying the maintenance fixed by the trial court 
concerned periodically monthwise by 7th day of 
every month of English calendar in her account.
7. Learned counsel for the revisionist 
no.1/wife is directed to provide the bank details of 
her account i.e. Bank Account Number, Name of 
Bank, Name of Branch & IFSC Code on 
WhatsApp number of the learned counsel for the 
respondent no.2/husband i.e. 9412089540, within 
24 hours. 
8. List this matter on 16.07.2025 for hearing. 
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.)
 22.04.2025
Akash

Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for 
the revisionists.

directed respondent no.2/husband to pay the 
entire arrears of maintenance fixed by the Trial

of the revisionist/wife and keep on paying the 
maintenance by 7th day of every month of

complied with the said order dated 22.04.2025.
6. Learned counsel for respondent 
no.2/husband shall file an affidavit specifying 
the payment made by him to the revisionist 
within a period of one week.
7. List this case on 31.07.2025 along with 
connected matter.

Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel 
for the revisionist.
2. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned A.G.A. 
along with Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, 
learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned 
counsel for private respondent.
4. Let the respondent-husband filed an 
affidavit positively within 10 days by 
disclosing his assets, movable and 
immovable including ITR of three years as 
well as the assets of parents and second 
wife.
5. List this case on 12.03.2026. In the 
meantime, the interim order passed by the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court dated 
21.12.2021 is modified by increasing the 
interim maintenance amount of Rs. 
5,000/- to Rs. 7,000/- and the same will 
be paid by the husband from March 2026 
onwards by crediting the same in the 
account in first week of each month.
6. In addition to this, the husband shall 
clear entire arrears towards the interim 
maintenance in terms of the order dated 
21.12.2021.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
